svg.title: Functional outcome matrix: AMD hypervisor qualification
svg.desc: Checks grouped by execution scope against cited build revisions. Every recorded status has a source key. Not recorded means no archived record for that check and build; it is not a pass, failure, or not-run result.
svg.text: Each column is a build in one scope. S-keys identify journal sources below.
NOT RECORDED = no record; a check absent from a panel has no records in any of its columns.
